what.text: This page follows refugees from Ghana living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 898 Ghanaian refugees in Germany, 5.6% of all refugees from Ghana.
Togo hosts the most Ghanaian refugees, followed by Canada, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Ghana, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 and 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 1308 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 7136, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
